name: Umaji (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Umaji village emblem in white: an outlined lozenge enclosing stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Umaji, a village in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Umaji village emblem — an outlined lozenge enclosing stylised characters
